notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Change log 1.05
- \[Experimental] You can now hit X to fast forward to the end of a line of dialogue.

- Rescaled maps and enemies to make hacking easier.

- Fixed bug where 4 missiles in a square would brick the game.

- Lowered the unlock price of the missile and splitter (so hard players can try them out).

- Fixed bug with exiting and starting a new save, resulting in some events not playing.

- Now asks you to confirm before overwriting your save.
